item.title: Reduction Semantics 紀錄
item.description:
最近在讀 A Syntactic Approach to Type Soundness (A.K. Wright and M. Felleisen., 1994) 時，他們的文章中使用 reduction semantics 來描述語意。因為我對這套使用 context 的描述法不熟，所以在這裡想要記錄一下。

Syntax

他們使用的語言 syntax 如下：

$$ e ::= v\ |\ e_1 e_2\ |\ \text{let } x \text{ be } e_1 \text{ in } e_2\ \ \ \ \text{(Expressions)}\\ v ::= c\ |\ x\ |\ \text{Y}\ |\ \lambda x.e\ \ \ \ \text{(Values)} $$

其中 $c$ 是一些額外定義的 constant （$c \in Const$），$x$ 是變數（$x \in Var$），$\text{Y}$ 是弄出 recursion 用的 fixpoint combinator。

item.title: Validity of Binary Search in Leetcode 2141
item.description:
From the editorial:

We can freely use every battery except the largest 4 to increase the total running time. Because we can freely swap batteries in 0 time, all the extra power is interchangeable. We can take this extra power and “transfer” it to the batteries in live. Let extra be the sum of all the extra power.

It seems to me that it claims that the number of batteries in the “extra” part doesn’t matter, but how could 7 batteries with power 1 the same as 1 batteries with power 7?
